title: PH eyes additional BrahMos missile systems—Teodoro
summary: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. expressed the Philippines’ intention to acquire additional BrahMos supersonic cruise missile systems from India, while seeking modifications to make the system…

blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. expressed the Philippines’ intention to acquire additional BrahMos supersonic cruise missile systems from India, while seeking modifications to make the system more suitable for the country’s geographic and infrastructure conditions.
